name: ontology-lookup
description: An Agent Skill that tags the things an agent writes about with registry identifiers: the first mention of a thing in a passage gets its CURIE inline as «term» [CURIE], with Bioregistry prefixes (GO:0005739, wikidata:Q42, glottolog:stan1293), so logs can be resolved and indexed later. 17 open ontologies and registries in the starter set, each with a cited reference file; SNOMED CT excluded for its licence. Ships a dependency-free Node lookup script (search, --resolve CURIE, --lineage word).
